meta.description: Ball speeds and air time (DFL, our kinematics)
meta.source: DFL/Sportec open data: Bassek, M., Rein, R., Weber, H., Memmert, D. (2025). An integrated dataset of spatiotemporal and event data in elite soccer. Scientific Data 12:195. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-025-04505-y. Licence: CC-BY 4.0. Aggregate statistics only; no raw, frame-level or person-level data.
meta.licence: CC-BY 4.0 (data); these aggregates are derived statistics with attribution

config.xg_angle_slope_source: Soccermatics angle-only logistic fit, logit(xG) = -3.52 + 2.84 * theta, on 8,451 shots of the 2017/18 Premier League in the open Wyscout data (Pappalardo et al. 2019, Scientific Data 6:236, doi:10.1038/s41597-019-0247-7, CC BY 4.0)

conventions.coordinates: metres, centre origin, team-attacking direction: the team attacks +x, left is +y; pitch 105 x 68 m
conventions.validity: valid samples only (valid_kinematics = true); estimated gap samples never count for speed, peaks or per-90 values
conventions.per90: normalised on measured (valid) time of each player-match (team decision 2026-10-24); see coverage
conventions.ball: ball status and possession are the provider's (never derived from a stationary ball)

notes: Our kinematics only (Savitzky-Golay ball speed on valid live samples). pass_speed_ms (with p99, read by R-SHOT-POWER): peak valid ball speed in the 0.5 s after the kick of a located open-play pass, stopped before the next touch. long_pass_speed_ms: the same for passes >= 30 m. shot_speed_ms: peak valid ball speed in the 0.5 s after the kick of a confirmed open-play shot (Materials/METRICS.md), headers excluded (v4.2: ball above 1.5 m at the kick, the header test of R-SHOT-POWER); soft shots included.
circulation_speed_ms: every valid live ball sample with a team in possession (sample level); circulation_speed_median_per_team_match_ms: one median per team-match.
progression_speed_ms: forward ball displacement (attacking direction) / duration of possession runs >= 3 s.

air_time_high_pass_s: located passes annotated high; from the kick to the first landing (ball back below 0.5 m after rising above 1 m) or to the next touch, whichever comes first; passes whose ball never rises above the threshold, or with invalid ball samples in the flight, are left out.
Realism range for maximal kicks: 18-35 m/s (Kellis & Katis 2007, Materials/PHYSICAL_LIMITS.md). Limit: 211 km/h in live play.
